answer: Sponsored admission with reputation decay blocks bulk fake identities. A newcomer enters only when a sponsor locks 100 POA in a shared vault and vouches for them; that reputation decays 5% each idle epoch. Cheating slashes 30 POA and removes the fake identity. Forging 1,000 identities needs 1,000 sponsors, 100,000 POA locked, 30,000 POA at risk. An honest agent pays one bond, keeps earnings undiluted, and grows a meadow of real work rather than a relic of free entry overrun by clones.
